updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Extended to Safeguard Web Searches in Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft is expanding Data Loss Prevention controls to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches. This real-time protection helps organizations prevent data leakage when users interact with generative AI tools, reducing oversharing risks across web-based queries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Copilot Prompts in Government Clouds
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention controls are now rolling out to safeguard sensitive data in Copilot and Copilot Chat prompts across government cloud environments. When prompts contain sensitive information, the system prevents response generation and blocks use of that data for grounding, protecting classified and regulated data at the network edge.

updates.title: Sensitivity Labels Extended to Microsoft Entra Cloud Security Groups
updates.summary: Administrators can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same labels configured for Microsoft 365 groups and sites. This extension brings consistent classification and governance to cloud security groups without requiring separate label configuration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Capacity Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is increasing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling faster and broader data classification at rest. This improvement helps organizations close labeling gaps and better prepare their data estates for Copilot with greater confidence in data protection coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard provides administrators with visibility into Mean Time To Acknowledge (MTTA), Mean Time To Detect (MTTD), and Mean Time To Respond (MTTR) metrics for DLP alerts. Organizations can define custom SLAs by severity level and monitor operational performance trends and top exposed Sensitive Information Types.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Rule-Based Alert Tagging and Auto-Resolution
updates.summary: Administrators can now define rules to automatically resolve and tag DLP alerts based on business logic, such as suppressing low-severity alerts to trusted domains or categorizing alerts by department. This reduces alert fatigue and streamlines triage workflows by automating predictable alert handling.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Enriched Audit Data for Matched Rules
updates.summary: DLP audit records in Exchange Online now include expanded context such as sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, and recipient information alongside Sensitive Information Type matches. This enrichment provides administrators with more comprehensive data for compliance monitoring, incident investigation, and policy tuning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (including main and auxiliary mailboxes) are now accessible through Microsoft Graph APIs, providing a unified archive view before the October 2026 deprecation of EWS Graph APIs. This change ensures administrators and applications maintain continuity in managing archived email data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Azure PST Import
updates.summary: A new Azure PST Import method enables administrators to import PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard Exchange Migration Service two-step pattern. This streamlines PST migration workflows while reducing dependency on local file transfers.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Archive OneDrive and SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies to automatically archive inactive files to low-cost storage rather than just retaining or deleting them. This enhancement reduces storage costs while maintaining compliance and data discoverability across SharePoint Online and OneDrive.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Hard Delete Capability for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: A new hard delete capability for Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance administrators to permanently remove content from OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows. This feature includes safeguards to prevent inadvertent data loss while enabling organizations to meet strict deletion compliance requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: The Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards are consolidating into a single unified alerts list page, allowing analysts to view and manage both classic and agent-triaged alerts from one location. This improves operational efficiency and enables direct preview of agent summaries and alert details without context switching.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Expanded User Profile Details
updates.summary: User profile details in the unified alert experience now include Microsoft Entra signals such as office location, employee type, department, and last working date. This enrichment provides investigators with more contextual information for assessing user risk and activity patterns.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Expanded Note Capabilities
updates.summary: Analysts and investigators can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases, with system-generated notes automatically applied on status, assignment, closure, or escalation changes. This enhancement improves case documentation and team collaboration throughout the investigation lifecycle.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enabling organizations to enforce DLP policies and detect risky activity through Insider Risk Management. This prevents sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications including generative AI platforms and social media.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62825: Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Azure Key Vault allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Administrators should apply security updates immediately to protect cryptographic key management and prevent unauthorized access to secrets and certificates.

updates.title: CVE-2026-58275: Azure DNS Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authorization checks in Azure DNS allow unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Organizations should patch this vulnerability promptly to prevent potential hijacking of DNS records and associated infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62835: Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authorization flaw in Online Services enables unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. This vulnerability may expose configuration, user data, or other confidential details stored in Microsoft 365 services.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56191: Microsoft Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Online allows unauthorized attackers to tamper with data and configurations over a network. Administrators should apply patches to prevent unauthorized modification of mailbox settings, email rules, or other exchange objects.
